_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. Steam search/details are keyless and the email scrape is light HTTP, so compute per lead is tiny. First 10 qualified_lead per run are free for validation.

listing.eventDescription: One game with studio, publisher, genres, release date, price, and review count, but no studio website.

lead.eventDescription: A game with the studio website, plus studio, publisher, genres, release date, price, and review count.

qualified_lead.eventDescription: A game with a scraped contact email and reviews at or above the qualified bar. A reachable, established studio. The first 10 qualified_lead per run are free so you can validate output.
